overview: TradeNest Naturals manufactures dehydrated Terminalia Chebula Powder in India for global B2B buyers. Sourced from mature harad fruits, the raw botanical undergoes cleaning, controlled drying, and precision grinding. Our processing produces a uniform 100 mesh powder with moisture levels maintained at or below eight percent. We operate as an FSSAI-licensed manufacturer delivering consistent quality for commercial formulations.

As an IEC-registered exporter, we support international trade with full export documentation and reliable supply schedules. The powder offers a stable twenty-four month shelf life when stored appropriately. We accommodate diverse business needs through bulk supply, custom mesh grinding, and private-label packaging options. Brands and distributors can source standard or customized volumes starting from a minimum order quantity of five kilograms.
highlights: Fine 100 mesh particle size with 98 percent passing through
Moisture content strictly maintained at or below 8 percent
Extended shelf life of 24 months when stored correctly
Manufactured without artificial additives, fillers, or synthetic preservatives
Produced from dehydrated Indian Terminalia chebula botanical raw materials
Standardized export classification under HS Code 12119099
applications: Hair care powder mixes and masks
industries: Contract packaging and private label brands
packaging: 25 kg multi-wall paper bags or HDPE containers

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for Terminalia Chebula Powder?
faqs.a: The minimum order quantity is 5 kg, catering to formulation trials as well as commercial manufacturing runs.

faqs.q: What packaging configurations are available for export and private label?
faqs.a: We offer bulk 25 kg bags and HDPE containers, 5 to 10 kg bags, as well as customized retail pouches and jars.

faqs.q: Can you provide custom mesh sizes for our manufacturing process?
faqs.a: Yes, while our standard powder is 100 mesh, we offer custom grinding and sieving upon request.

faqs.q: Do you provide product samples before placing a bulk order?
faqs.a: Yes, product samples are available upon request to assist with laboratory and formulation testing.

faqs.q: What manufacturing process is utilized for this herbal powder?
faqs.a: We employ a systematic 6-step process consisting of sourcing, cleaning and sorting, controlled drying, grinding and sieving, quality inspection, and dispatch.

faqs.q: What documentation support do you offer for international shipments?
faqs.a: As an IEC-registered exporter and FSSAI-licensed manufacturer, we provide complete export documentation support to ensure smooth customs clearance.
